title: Chapter 525
text:
As long as it was a machine controlled by artificial intelligence, the Virtual Technology intrusion could tamper with the data and gain control of the machine. Naturally, the spaceship was included. Everyone, please search (Book Net) for the most complete! What the hell!

The difficulty of infiltration depended on the intelligence level of the target machine. After successful infiltration, one would be constantly blocked by the enemy's intelligence. Every once in a while, one would have to go through a new authorization test. Only after passing would one be able to retain the operation authorization. The level of the operation authorization could be understood as how many positions one had unlocked …

As long as the first infiltration was completed and the data of the target artificial intelligence was obtained, the difficulty of the next infiltration would be reduced. Therefore, Virtual Mechanics were hated by everyone in the civil war. Every Mechanic who fell in love with them would feel as though their wife had turned into someone else's appearance.

The ability of a Virtual Mechanic was very suitable for space battles. Among the five Super classes, a Virtual Mechanic was the class with the highest efficiency against fleets.

The defense of the spaceship's AI firewall was very strong, and with Han Xiao's current standards, the success rate of his infiltration was not high. However, the auxiliary AI on his side would increase the success rate and the speed of his infiltration. Risda was an AI lifeform, and its calculation speed was extremely shocking. It would increase the chances of his judgement by at least thirty to forty percent.

On the battlefield, Han Xiao seized an assault ship and disabled it by firing its cannons. Then, he controlled it to crash into his companions and disrupt the enemy's formation.

This Dark-star assault team was shocked by the sudden turn of events. They had originally thought that the BlackLight Stealth would not be able to break through their defenses, so they had ignored it. They had not expected the other party to be able to break through the artificial firewall and invade their spaceship. They could not sit back and do nothing.

The assault team split up ten spaceships to engage the BlackLight Stealth, while the remaining spaceships fired at the surface of the planet while maintaining their formation.

The enemy's reaction was exactly what Han Xiao wanted. As long as he reduced the enemy's firepower on the surface, he would be able to buy more time. The BlackLight Stealth's configuration was extremely high, and speed was its greatest advantage. Ginette's driving skills were excellent, and she constantly dodged the crisscrossing green lights.

Boom boom boom —

In the sky, a pitch-black spaceship was being besieged by ten assault spaceships, flying left and right nimbly.

"The only way to get rid of these enemies is to board the ship. Other than those who are flying the spaceship, everyone go to different hatches and wait to be released!"

Han Xiao ordered loudly. He immediately opened up the Void Dragon mecha and connected the internal system of the mecha to the BlackLight Stealth. With a faint flash of light, the Virtual Intrusion interface appeared, forming a virtual projection on his arm. This way, he could operate the Virtual Intrusion without needing to stay in the spaceship. He also walked to the hatch like the others.

Han Xiao himself was also extremely strong, so he naturally made the best use of it.

"The enemy has 30 enemy ships. If we attack them one by one, we won't make it in time. We can only use destructive means." Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and the data he entered changed.

There were many forms of Virtual Technology infiltration. Seizing control rights was the act of bandits, which took the longest time. Other than that, there were also methods to tamper with part of the enemy's data to conceal or confuse them. These methods were often used to infiltrate. The most destructive method was to implant a virus or fill in a large amount of redundant data to destroy the intelligence of the target machine and temporarily paralyze most of the machine's functions. This method was the fastest and was equivalent to a direct punch.

The most direct method to destroy the intelligence was to let the intelligence on one's side fight against the intelligence of the enemy. With Risda's level, the intelligence of these Dark-star assault ships was not even comparable to children in front of him. He could easily tear apart these tool-type AI that had not even developed its own independent thought.

If seizing control rights was like snatching someone's wife, then destroying the intelligence was like breaking the other party's wife.

In terms of data flow, Risda was like a star, shooting out scorching torrents. The firewall of the assault ships was like a shield in the data layer, constantly blasting large holes in it. The AI structure inside was riddled with holes.

The results of the data battle were immediately reflected in the material world.

Hum hum hum!

With a series of loud sounds, the engines of the four assault ships suddenly stopped, and they rapidly fell downwards. The shields also flickered a few times before disappearing.

The AI controlling the entire spaceship was temporarily paralyzed, and it was unable to continue operating the spaceship. The pilots were flustered, and they could only try to switch to manual mode as they fell. Before they hit the ground, they had sufficient time to switch to manual mode.

However, at this moment, the BlackLight Stealth swooped down, and its laser cannon locked onto the four assault ships and opened fire. With a series of bangs, holes were blasted in the armor of the four enemy spaceships.

At the same time, with its absolute speed advantage, the BlackLight Stealth swept past the four enemy spaceships that had lost control. The mercenaries waiting at the hatch jumped out one after another, and the hooks in their hands shot out at the holes in the armor. The cables quickly retracted, dragging the mercenaries into the enemy spaceship.

Although the Dark-star assault ships had lost their shields, their armor still had a certain level of defense. The laser cannon would not be able to destroy the enemy spaceship so easily. If they wanted to quickly destroy the enemy spaceship, the best choice was to destroy it from the inside.

Furthermore, as long as they charged into the enemy spaceship, not only would they be able to destroy the enemy spaceship, they would also be able to use force to seize the spaceship!

Boom boom boom!

The mercenaries wreaked havoc inside, and the bodies of the four enemy spaceships exploded with flames. The Dark-star guards inside were completely unable to stop them, and the command room was completely wiped out.

The mercenaries quickly took over the spaceship. As the AI of the assault ship had been hammered into an idiot by Risda, there was no way to verify the pilot's authority. The mercenaries directly switched to manual mode to take control of the assault ship.

In an instant, there were four more battleships on Han Xiao's side, and the team suddenly grew larger. The four spaceships opened fire at the other Dark-star assault ships.

At this moment, the other six assault ships surrounding the BlackLight Stealth were also paralyzed. The mercenaries charged in and started a massacre, including Han Xiao.

Pa!

After flying into the hole in the armor, Han Xiao landed in the aisle of the spaceship. The mechanical wings behind him folded up, and a bunch of compressed orbs popped out from his wrist. The orbs turned into dozens of leopard-type mechanical beasts and two Oathkeepers, firing in all directions.

Boom boom boom!

Lasers shot in all directions, and explosions occurred one after another. The interior of the assault ship was quickly filled with smoke, and the cabin walls were torn into pieces. Following these openings, the mechanical warriors advanced toward the other areas of the spaceship, starting to clean up the Dark-star guards on the spaceship.

Han Xiao bumped his fists together, and two giant mechanical hands appeared beside him. He raised his fists and smashed through everything. There was no need for him to take a detour, and the obstacles in front of him were all smashed through. Everywhere he passed, there would be bent metal.

He ran in a straight line toward the command room of the spaceship.

Dozens of spaceship guards hurriedly rushed over and blocked in front of Han Xiao. A Dark-star warrior who looked like a captain shouted, "Stop him, don't …"

Before he could finish his words, Han Xiao waved his hand, and the giant mechanical hand slapped over. The flames in the surroundings were extinguished under the pressure of the wind, and before the captain could react, his line of sight was occupied by the metal hand that was rapidly enlarging.

Bang!

With a loud bang, the giant mechanical hand slapped the captain into the cabin wall of the tunnel, and the cabin wall caved in directly!

The palm moved away, and only a strangely shaped meat patty was left in the pit. Blood splattered everywhere, and this Grade C Dark-star warrior was killed in an instant. It was easier than swatting a fly.

In these assault ships, there were at most Grade C guards. It was basically impossible for Grade B Dark-star elite warriors to appear.

The rest of the guards were shocked. Without waiting for them to do anything, Han Xiao clapped his hands together, and the fingers of the two giant mechanical hands came together, quickly turning into a giant drill and spinning at high speed.

Woo woo woo!

The drill created a whistling sound in the wind!

The next moment, the two giant mechanical drills swept past, and no one could stop them. Screams were deafening, and in less than three seconds, all the guards in the way were crushed into pieces.

Blood was everywhere, and it was as gory as a slaughterhouse. Han Xiao was already used to such scenes, and he continued to move forward without any hesitation. All the enemies in the way were killed in an instant.

No one in this spaceship could withstand a single blow. Amidst the explosions and screams, Han Xiao drove Unparalleled all the way to the command room. Behind him was a hole that pierced through several levels.

The entire process took less than a minute, and it was as if he had entered a no-man's land!

After destroying everything that could breathe in the command room, Han Xiao came to the control panel and took control of this assault ship. He pulled the horse up and charged toward an empty enemy spaceship. At the same time, he multitasked and performed a Virtual Intrusion at a dazzling speed.

In order to save time, he did not plan to return to the BlackLight Stealth and directly drove the stolen assault ship into the enemy.

After cleaning up all the survivors in the spaceship, the mechanical warriors quickly returned to the command room and turned back into compressed orbs, automatically returning to Han Xiao's hands.

In this short period of time, Han Xiao took a look at the mission list on the interface.

[Godora's Ally] was a main storyline mission that focused on attacking the Dark-star spaceships. There were a few missions that included the requirement to destroy the Dark-star spaceships, such as [Fleet Killer] and [Direct Confrontation]. These two missions had extremely high rewards, and the simplest one was [Assault Ship Destroyer], which only required him to destroy five Dark-star spaceships. The reward was 630 EXP and 300 Godora Favorability.

Suddenly, a thought appeared in his mind.

Right, this mission was originally a main storyline for the players, but since they did not join Godora, they probably won't be able to trigger it …

Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he quickly retracted his attention. Seriously, just focus on fighting. Don't think about such trivial matters that would cause trouble for the players. He almost felt guilty.

He increased the horsepower and charged toward another enemy spaceship. The distance between them quickly closed, and the enemy spaceship grew larger and larger in his vision. He could clearly see the outer armor of the enemy spaceship.

Boom!

The two spaceships collided, and the bow of the spaceship stabbed into the belly of the enemy spaceship. Metal fragments flew everywhere!

Han Xiao drove the spaceship and fired at close range, creating a few holes. He then broke through the cabin wall on his side and flew out, entering the enemy spaceship and starting a one-sided massacre once again.

Dark-star spaceships fell one after another. Some fell to the ground, some were captured by the mercenaries to fire at the enemy, and some were blown into pieces in the air. The Black Star Mercenary quickly gained control of the situation and began to surround and attack the remaining Dark-star spaceships.

At the same time, the Six Nations and the Sanctuary were paying attention to the satellite images. Seeing Black Star's power, they could not help but feel excited and surprised.

This kind of reliable feeling … it was as if Black Star was the guardian of this planet!

—
